scope: token usage of the Claude Code stream-json profile: every native member whose key names tokens (SourceAvailability.TOKEN_KEY) in the registered recordings of the bindings below, and every member inside an obligation's payload. Members outside this family (durations, counts, statuses, content) are not judged by this catalog; the field-disposition catalog still accounts for them.
owner_rule: a record whose parent_tool_use_id names a tool call belongs to the child core of that call (child:<id>); a record without one belongs to main (the contract's owner_routing)
rule_of_obligation: An obligation is a required canonical outcome: every native occurrence its trigger selects in a registered recording (counted from the native record alone, before any candidate output is read) must reach its destination in the owner's core with every stated value, and the oracle's own source profile must expect it. Retention of the containing record, a broad subtree disposition or another owner's passing check never discharges it. A residual is a reviewed token-named member that owes no canonical outcome (vendor_specific) or whose classification is an open question (unresolved); an unresolved residual keeps the support claim pending. meaning_digest is sha256 over the canonical JSON of {trigger, destination, observation}: a changed meaning needs a new revision.
